mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 30 days compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods of FEDFUNDS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in monetary tightening cycles when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods of PAYEMS growth (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1400.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) signal a dual stress in labor market and supply conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in high unemployment periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
